primitives.name: Recursive Out-of-Bounds Penalty
primitives.verbatim_quote: If the ball goes out of bounds before striking a player, it must be kicked out again, and if this occurs twice in succession, it shall be given to Positions of Opponents at Kick-out.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: n: consecutive failure count (dimensionless), P_opponent: possession probability assigned to opposing team
primitives.assumptions: Discrete event counter resets upon successful engagement; binary success/failure states.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Deterministic handover occurs exactly at n = 2, bypassing further stochastic evaluation.
